common.footer: You are receiving this email because you have an account at Oppenheimer.
common.pasteLink: Or paste this into your browser:

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.preview: Reset your Oppenheimer password — the link works once and expires soon.
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your account. Choose a new one and you'll be back in your workspace.
passwordReset.helper: This link can only be used once and expires soon. If it has, request a new one from the sign-in page.
passwordReset.closing: Didn't ask for this? Ignore this email — your password stays the same.
passwordReset.footerNote: This is a security email, so you always receive it.

emailVerification.subject: Verify your email
emailVerification.preview: Verify your Oppenheimer email address to finish setting up your account.
emailVerification.heading: Verify your email
emailVerification.body: Confirm this email address to finish setting up your account and keep it secure.
emailVerification.helper: This verification link expires shortly and can only be used for this account.
emailVerification.closing: Didn't create an account? You can safely ignore this email.
emailVerification.footerNote: This is a security email, so you always receive it.

welcome.subject: Welcome to Oppenheimer
welcome.heading: Welcome to Oppenheimer
welcome.body: Your account has been created successfully. We're excited to have you on board.
welcome.support: If you have any questions, reply to this email and our team will help.

invitation.subject: You're invited to {{organizationName}}
invitation.preview: {{inviterName}} invited you to the {{organizationName}} workspace — set up your account.
invitation.heading: Join the {{organizationName}} workspace
invitation.body: Accept the invitation to start working with your team.
invitation.benefitWorkspace: Everything your team has filed in this workspace, in one place
invitation.benefitCollaboration: A place to work with the people who invited you
invitation.benefitAccount: One account for every workspace you belong to
invitation.ignore: Not expecting this invite? You can safely ignore this email.

hostPaired.subject: A new machine was paired with your account
hostPaired.preview: {{hostName}} can now run sessions for you. If that wasn't you, act now.
hostPaired.heading: A new machine was paired
hostPaired.body: {{hostName}} ({{machine}}) was paired with your account and can now run coding sessions for you. Its key fingerprint starts with {{fingerprint}}.
hostPaired.helper: If you paired it, there is nothing to do. On that machine, the runner’s status command shows the same fingerprint, so you can check it is the one you meant.
hostPaired.closing: Don't recognise it? Someone used one of your pairing tokens. The console cannot unpair a host yet. If you can reach the machine, run the runner’s uninstall command on it; if you cannot, unpair it through the API with DELETE /v1/hosts/{{hostId}}. Your unspent tokens expire within the hour.
hostPaired.footerNote: This is a security email, so you always receive it.

hostNetworkChanged.subject: {{hostName}} is connecting from a new network
hostNetworkChanged.preview: {{hostName}} moved from {{from}} to {{to}}. If you did not move it, act now.
hostNetworkChanged.heading: A host moved to a new network
hostNetworkChanged.body: {{hostName}} used to connect from {{from}}. It now connects from {{to}}, at {{ip}}.
hostNetworkChanged.helper: If you took the machine somewhere new, or its provider changed, there is nothing to do. We only write when the country or the network operator changes, not for every new address.
hostNetworkChanged.closing: Don't recognise the move? The host's key may be in use somewhere else. Remove the host from Settings, or through the API with DELETE /v1/hosts/{{hostId}}; its runner is refused from that moment, and the sessions on it are stopped.
hostNetworkChanged.footerNote: This is a security email, so you always receive it.
